The founding statute: Part VI duty to provide information and Part VIII Integrated National Civil Registration System, which set out which other systems consume civil registration data

Joint communique of 21-22 November 2025 placing NCRA in the bilateral Digital Cooperation Working Group and naming digital identity alignment in the NITDA-DSTI-Miden-Monime partnership; file already staged this run by a sibling slice, not restaged

Draft Bill to repeal and replace the Companies Act 2009 and the Registration of Business Act 2007, with a Unified Business Board, one-stop shop and statutory timelines

The controlling statute: Part III provides for the Register of Voters and makes the register in force conclusive evidence of entitlement to vote
Completed UNDP study dated 5 December 2025 setting out voter registration data extraction options including direct API integration, periodic transfer and database replication
Distinct event: ECSL status report of 13 February 2026 on independent monitoring of voter registration and the proposed use of national identity cards in place of ECSL voter identity cards
The enacting statute establishing the National Land Commission, its Title Registry and the National Land Register; file already staged this run by a sibling slice, not restaged
Official start of customary land registration field activities across four sections of Bekeh Loko Chiefdom, with the Chiefdom Consent Form signed
Distinct event: public validation of Rogbere Section 1 parcel maps in Maforki Chiefdom, the quality-control step before rights are registered
The founding statute for the population register: it establishes NCRA, compulsory registration, the personal registration file, the NIN and the Integrated National Civil Registration System

NCRA Director-General announced on 5 March 2026 that the Maternal and Child Health Handbook will be recognised as a valid document for birth registration; file already staged this run by a sibling slice, not restaged

Section 20 amends section 173 of the Income Tax Act 2000 to require a register, called the tax register, of all persons assessable to tax, each assigned a unique automated system generated TIN
